integrity: Analytic lower-bound and explicit four-class upper-bound proofs supplied in RESULT.md; exact rational witness certificate in CHECK.py; earlier mixture-comparison literature not fully accessible, so historical priority is provisional.

title: Four mortality classes are necessary for two hazard-rank reversals under strict survival ordering
